title: General Health, Safety and Environmental Protection
objective: Recognise general workplace health, safety and environmental protection concepts.
safety_boundary: Recognition and awareness only; no emergency or hazardous-work procedures are taught.

sections.heading: 1. Hazards and risk
sections.body: A hazard is something with potential to cause harm. Workplace controls are used to reduce exposure and risk.

sections.heading: 2. Safety information
sections.body: Signs, labels, procedures and authorised instructions communicate important workplace controls.

sections.heading: 3. Environmental care
sections.body: Waste, spills, materials and work activities must be managed according to applicable workplace requirements.

sections.heading: 4. Escalation
sections.body: Conditions outside a learner's authority or understanding must be reported to a competent person.

options: Something with potential to cause harm
